fullTextEN: The old grandpa goes to find the cat.

fullTextZH: 第一天老爷爷看到很多很多狗。
fullTextEN: On the first day, the old grandpa saw many, many dogs.
On the second day, the old grandpa searched.

fullTextZH: 老爷爷看到很多很多鸟。
fullTextEN: The old grandpa saw many, many birds.
But the old grandma doesn't like birds.
Ah, so the old grandpa continues to search.
On the third day, the old grandpa searched.

fullTextZH: 可是老爷爷看到很多很多人。
fullTextEN: But the old grandpa saw many, many people.
So the old grandpa doesn't want people.

fullTextZH: 老爷爷找到了很多很多猫。嗯！
fullTextEN: The old man found many, many cats. Hmm!

fullTextZH: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十。
fullTextEN: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

fullTextZH: 有的猫很瘦，有的猫是黄色的，
fullTextEN: Some cats are very thin, some cats are yellow,
Some cats like to eat fish,
Some cats like to eat mice.

fullTextZH: 都可爱，所以老爷爷要所有的猫。
fullTextEN: All are cute, so the old man wants all the cats.

fullTextZH: 洗碗；有的猫可以洗衣服，
fullTextEN: Wash dishes; some cats can do laundry,

fullTextZH: 有的猫每天唱歌啦啦啦，
fullTextEN: Some cats sing every day la la la,
Some cats watch movies every day,
Some cats drink coffee every day,

fullTextZH: 你看，所有的猫都很开心！
fullTextEN: Look, all the cats are happy!
But they are all very lazy.
The old grandma is busy every day.
Give the cats massages every day.
What about you? Do you have pets?
Do you like children or pets?
